models: 24 extractive and abstractive summarization systems (SOTA between 2017 and 2019)
answer_1.outputs: summaries generated by summarization systems and LLMs

answer_2.quote: To compute the correlations with humans, we use the human judgments available in SummEval and gather new human ratings for GUMSum on both human and LLM-generated summaries ( §3.3)

answer_4.quote: We hired three Master's students in Computational Linguistics and tasked them to evaluate four LLM outputs ( §3.2) and five human references ( §3.1), following Fabbri et al. ( )'s criteria. ... using a Likert scale of 1-5
answer_4.guideline: following Fabbri et al.'s criteria; assessed summaries based on coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance
